# IdentityNone

IdentityNone is a Ziti identity without an enrollment. It suits identities that authenticate through an external JWT signer.

| | |
|---|---|
| API version | `ziti.crossplane.io/v1alpha1` |
| Scope | Namespaced |
| In Ziti | identity without an enrollment, `/edge/management/v1/identities` |
| Updated with | `PATCH`: a setting that is left out of the spec is left alone in Ziti |

## Example

From [`examples/identity/none.yaml`](../../examples/identity/none.yaml):

```yaml
# An identity without an enrollment: it authenticates through an external
# JWT signer, which recognizes it by externalId. authPolicyId takes the name
# or the ID of an auth policy; "default" is the policy every Ziti network has.
apiVersion: ziti.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
kind: IdentityNone
metadata:
  name: sso-user
spec:
  providerConfigRef:
    kind: ProviderConfig
    name: default
  forProvider:
    name: sso-user
    externalId: sso-user@example.com
    authPolicyId: default
    roleAttributes:
      - web-clients
    appData:
      department: engineering
```

## Settings: `spec.forProvider`

| Field | Type | Default | Field in Ziti | What it does in Ziti |
|-------|------|---------|---------------|----------------------|
| `name` | string, required |  | `name` | Name of the identity. |
| `appData` | map of strings |  | `appData` | AppData is a map of data for the applications that use the identity. |
| `authPolicyId` | string |  | `authPolicyId`, as an ID | AuthPolicyID is the name or ID of the auth policy that governs how the identity authenticates. Ziti assigns its default auth policy when this is not set. |
| `defaultHostingCost` | integer |  | `defaultHostingCost` | DefaultHostingCost is the cost of the terminators the identity hosts. From 0 to 65535. |
| `defaultHostingPrecedence` | string |  | `defaultHostingPrecedence` | DefaultHostingPrecedence is the precedence of the terminators the identity hosts. One of `default`, `required`, `failed`. |
| `enrollmentDuration` | string |  | `expiresAt` of the enrollment that replaces one that expired or is gone | EnrollmentDuration is how long an enrollment token is valid that replaces one that expired or is gone, 180m when this is not set. It does not apply to the first token, which is valid for as long as the Ziti controller is configured to make it, and an identity without an enrollment has no use for it. Rule: enrollmentDuration must be at least 5m. |
| `externalId` | string |  | `externalId` | ExternalID identifies the identity to an external JWT signer. |
| `isAdmin` | boolean | `false` | `isAdmin` | IsAdmin grants admin privileges to the identity. |
| `roleAttributes` | list of strings |  | `roleAttributes` | RoleAttributes are the attributes policies select the identity by, as "#attribute". |
| `serviceHostingCosts` | map of integers |  | `serviceHostingCosts`, keyed by service ID | ServiceHostingCosts overrides the hosting cost per service. Keys are service names or IDs. |
| `serviceHostingPrecedences` | map of strings |  | `serviceHostingPrecedences`, keyed by service ID | ServiceHostingPrecedences overrides the hosting precedence (default, required, failed) per service. Keys are service names or IDs. |
| `tags` | map of strings |  | `tags` | Tags is a map of tags. |
| `type` | string | `Default` | `type` | Type of the identity. It cannot be changed after creation. One of `Default`, `User`, `Device`, `Service`. |

The settings every managed resource has, such as `spec.providerConfigRef`,
`spec.managementPolicies` and `spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef`, are described
in [Concepts](../concepts.md).

## How it behaves

- The identity is created without an enrollment and never gets a token. It suits identities that sign in with a token of an [`ExternalJWTSigner`](externaljwtsigner.md), which finds them by `externalId` or by their ID, and identities of a [`CertificateAuthority`](certificateauthority.md) that takes the external ID from the certificate.
- `enrollmentDuration` has no effect on this kind.
- `authPolicyId` and the keys of `serviceHostingCosts` and `serviceHostingPrecedences` take names or IDs. Two keys that name the same service, by its name and by its ID, must have the same value.
- `tags`, `appData`, `serviceHostingCosts` and `serviceHostingPrecedences` are cleared in Ziti when they are left out of the spec. Other optional settings that are left out are not managed.
- `type` cannot be changed after creation.
- Before the identity is deleted its hosting settings per service are dropped: Ziti keeps them when a service is deleted and then refuses to delete the identity.

## When something goes wrong

- The identity cannot sign in: its auth policy must allow the method (`primary.extJwt` or `primary.cert`), and `externalId` must be what the signer finds in the claim it reads.
- `no entity named "..." in auth-policies` in `Synced`: `authPolicyId` names a policy that does not exist yet.

Create, update, drift, deletion in Ziti and deletion of the resource are covered by the end-to-end test, see [Testing](../testing.md).
